title: viola arguta var. meridionalis
intro: Viola arguta var. meridionalis, commonly known as the Chinese violet or fragrant violet, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the viola genus. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Viola arguta var. meridionalis are attributed to its calming and soothing properties, which can help alleviate stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
